sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current red block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

print("Current nodes:")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] != 'S':
        print(f"  {n['color']} id={n['id']}: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary'][:4]}")

# Get red block positions
r_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R']
print(f"\nRed blocks ({len(r_nodes)}): {[(n['boundary'][0], n['pixels']) for n in r_nodes]}")

# Get character position
w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 100]
char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
print(f"Character at: {char_pos}")

# Try to absorb more red blocks by moving and pressing SPACE
# The pattern seems to be: move character, press SPACE, absorb red block
# Let me try different movements to absorb the remaining 3 red blocks

# First, let me try pressing SPACE again to see the cycle
result = action(['SPACE'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
total_n = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N')
total_r = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R')
w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 100]
char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
print(f"\nAfter SPACE: N={total_n}, R={total_r}, char={char_pos}")

# Try moving and pressing SPACE to absorb more red blocks
# Let me try different directions
for direction in ['RIGHT', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'UP']:
    result = action([direction, 'SPACE'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    total_n = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N')
    total_r = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R')
    w_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] > 100]
    char_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
    print(f"After {direction}+SPACE: N={total_n}, R={total_r}, char={char_pos}")
    if total_r == 0:
        print("ALL RED BLOCKS ABSORBED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
